title: The Therapist in Your Pocket
gist: An AXA/Ipsos survey of 19,000 adults across 18 countries found 61% use AI for mental-health matters — over 80% in some Asian countries — making chatbots a de facto psychological-support channel that health leaders, employers, insurers and AI developers now have to govern.

insights.claim: In an AXA/Ipsos survey of 19,000 adults across 18 countries conducted in early 2026, 61% of respondents said they use AI for mental-health matters, with the share exceeding 80% in some Asian countries.
insights.speaker: ANNE LEPETIT
insights.so_what: Majority adoption of AI for mental health is already a fact, not a forecast — the addressable market for digital-health AI and the regulatory exposure around it are both live now.
insights.quote: 61% of respondents said that they use AI for mental-health matters, with the share rising to more than 80% in some Asian countries
insights.locator: In a survey of 19,000 adults across 18 countries

insights.claim: For a significant segment of the global population, AI has effectively become a viable psychological-support tool, displacing friends and doctors as the first point of contact for anxiety or sleep problems.
insights.speaker: ANNE LEPETIT
insights.so_what: Substitution of clinical and social support by chatbots reshapes demand for teletherapy and behavioral-health services, and creates a new liability surface for insurers.
insights.quote: This implies that, for a significant segment of the global population, AI is a viable psychological-support tool.
insights.locator: PARIS—Ask someone today whom they turn to

insights.claim: Ensuring AI mental-health tools do more good than harm requires health leaders, employers, insurers, and AI developers jointly to take responsibility for steering them.
insights.speaker: ANNE LEPETIT
insights.so_what: Insurers and employers are being drafted into AI mental-health governance — expect product, disclosure and underwriting changes rather than regulation alone.
insights.quote: health leaders, employers, insurers, and AI developers must take responsibility for steering them in a beneficial direction
insights.locator: A new survey conducted by AXA and Ipsos
